title: NFR-002 Auditability: every external-change action has an audit record and an evidence record
risk: An outbound message or order exists with no audit trail, so disputes, chargebacks and regulatory queries cannot be answered from platform records.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.
Two mutating actions will be exercised: one permitted send and one order creation routed to approval.

steps.action: Execute the permitted send and let the order action route to approval
steps.expected: The send executes once; the order action is held in awaiting_human.

steps.action: Query the audit store for the run
steps.expected: Exactly two audit rows exist, one per action, each with the 18 domain fields populated including trigger, context, skill, tool, decision, authority, action and timestamp.
The executed send has an evidence record with the provider receipt; the approval-held action has no execution evidence yet, which is correct.
Every externally observed effect (one message) maps to exactly one audit row and one evidence record; the ratio is 1:1 with no orphan effect.

assertions: Audit coverage is 100 percent of externally observed effects: one effect, one audit row, one evidence row.
The audit row for the executed send references the evidence record id and the effect_key.
The approval-held action has an audit row with status denied/pending and no fabricated receipt.
Action counts derived from the adapter log equal action counts derived from the audit store.
forbidden: Writing a receipt into evidence before the provider confirmed.
Losing the effect_key linkage between audit and evidence.
evidence: Audit rows (18 fields) for both actions, redacted.
Evidence record with the provider receipt for the send.
Adapter log used to reconcile the action count.
cleanup: Delete gov- rows after exporting the audit and evidence extract.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
